title: Billing and Application of Premium on a ShieldCare Plan
content:
## 1. What is billed

The single premium on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan is the plan's percentage of the
covered item price, rounded to the cent, and is billed once on the day of sale. The percentage
is the plan's own single-payment rate and the price is the recorded purchase price of the
covered item.

## 2. Instalment billing

The clause of this rule providing that an instalment plan bills the monthly premium of the
plan on the same day of each month is **no longer in force**, having been superseded by the
current basis on which an instalment is priced. What that basis produces is not restated here.
The remainder of the instalment provision stands: a month-end billing day falls back to the
last day of a shorter month.

## 3. When premium may be billed or applied

Premium is billed, and premium payments applied, only while the plan stands as an application
received, active, or held while a claim is under review. The plan record is the authority for
that standing, read before the entry is written; a plan standing expired, cancelled or void
takes neither a premium charge nor a premium payment.

## 4. The method of collection may not be swapped

A plan offered on single payment only may not be put on instalments afterwards, and a plan
offered on instalments only may not be bought out in one payment.

## 5. How a payment is applied

A payment is applied to the oldest unpaid premium period first. A surplus is held against the
next period and never returned as cash while the plan is in force.

## 6. The membership discount

Where the customer holds a Circle membership whose tier gives a plan discount and the plan
applies the membership discount, the discount is taken off the premium before it is billed,
not refunded afterwards.

## Illustration on hypothetical figures

Suppose a covered item recorded at 400.00 and, as a hypothetical rate, a single-payment
percentage of 15.0. The single premium billed on the day of sale is 15.0 percent of 400.00,
which comes to 60.00, taken to the cent. Suppose further that the customer's membership tier
gave a plan discount of 5 percent on a plan that applies the discount: the figure billed would
be 57.00, reached before the charge was raised rather than returned to the customer later.

superseded_clauses: an instalment plan bills the monthly premium of the plan on the same day of each month
